Optional fields:

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

root@63cb3c0c3c07:/home/user# cat /home/user/artifact-sync/sync.sh
#!/bin/bash
#
# Maven artifact sync script
# Syncs artifacts from upstream to local repository
#

ARTIFACTS_FILE="/home/user/artifact-sync/artifacts.txt"
CACHE_DIR="/home/user/artifact-sync/cache"
REPO_DIR="/var/repo/maven"

# Convert GAV coordinate to path
# e.g., com.example:core:1.2.0 -> com/example/core/1.2.0/core-1.2.0.jar
gav_to_path() {
    local gav="$1"
    local group=$(echo "$gav" | cut -d: -f1 | tr '.' '/')
    local artifact=$(echo "$gav" | cut -d: -f2)
    local version=$(echo "$gav" | cut -d: -f3)
    echo "${group}/${artifact}/${version}/${artifact}-${version}.jar"
}

echo "Starting artifact sync at $(date)"
echo "Reading artifacts from $ARTIFACTS_FILE"

while IFS= read -r gav || [ -n "$gav" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$gav" || "$gav" =~ ^# ]] && continue

    echo "Processing: $gav"

    JAR_PATH=$(gav_to_path "$gav")
    CACHED_FILE="${CACHE_DIR}/${JAR_PATH}"
    REPO_FILE="${REPO_DIR}/${JAR_PATH}"
    REPO_DIR_PATH=$(dirname "$REPO_FILE")

    # Ensure repo directory exists
    mkdir -p "$REPO_DIR_PATH"

    # Check if cached file exists
    if [ ! -f "$CACHED_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  WARNING: Cache file not found: $CACHED_FILE"
        continue
    fi

    # Compute SHA1 of cached file and write to repo
    SHA1=$(sha1sum "$CACHED_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    echo "$SHA1" > "${REPO_FILE}.sha1"
    echo "  SHA1: $SHA1"

    # Copy jar to repo (BUG: typo in variable name - CACHE_FILE vs CACHED_FILE)
    cp "$CACHE_FILE" "$REPO_FILE"

    echo "  Synced to: $REPO_FILE"

done < "$ARTIFACTS_FILE"

echo "Sync completed at $(date)"

#!/bin/bash

CACHE_DIR="/home/user/artifact-sync/cache"
REPO_DIR="/var/repo/maven"

echo "Finding and fixing zero-byte JAR files..."
echo ""

find "$REPO_DIR" -name '*.jar' -size 0 | while read -r jar_file; do
    echo "Processing: $jar_file"
    
    # Get relative path from repo
    rel_path="${jar_file#$REPO_DIR/}"
    cache_file="${CACHE_DIR}/${rel_path}"
    sha1_file="${jar_file}.sha1"
    
    # Check if cache file exists
    if [ ! -f "$cache_file" ]; then
        echo "  ERROR: Cache file not found: $cache_file"
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if sha1 file exists
    if [ ! -f "$sha1_file" ]; then
        echo "  ERROR: SHA1 file not found: $sha1_file"
        continue
    fi
    
    # Copy from cache
    cp "$cache_file" "$jar_file"
    echo "  Copied from cache ($(stat -c%s "$jar_file") bytes)"
    
    # Verify SHA1
    expected_sha1=$(cat "$sha1_file" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    actual_sha1=$(sha1sum "$jar_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    
    if [ "$expected_sha1" = "$actual_sha1" ]; then
        echo "  ✓ SHA1 verified: $actual_sha1"
    else
        echo "  ✗ SHA1 MISMATCH!"
        echo "    Expected: $expected_sha1"
        echo "    Actual:   $actual_sha1"
    fi
    echo ""
done

echo "Verification complete. Checking for remaining zero-byte JARs..."
zero_count=$(find "$REPO_DIR" -name '*.jar' -size 0 | wc -l)
echo "Zero-byte JARs remaining: $zero_count"
EOF

#!/bin/bash

REPO_DIR="/var/repo/maven"
mismatch_count=0
verified_count=0

find "$REPO_DIR" -name '*.jar' | while read -r jar_file; do
    sha1_file="${jar_file}.sha1"
    
    if [ ! -f "$sha1_file" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Missing SHA1 file for $jar_file"
        mismatch_count=$((mismatch_count + 1))
        continue
    fi
    
    expected_sha1=$(cat "$sha1_file" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    actual_sha1=$(sha1sum "$jar_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    
    if [ "$expected_sha1" = "$actual_sha1" ]; then
        verified_count=$((verified_count + 1))
    else
        echo "MISMATCH: $jar_file"
        echo "  Expected: $expected_sha1"
        echo "  Actual:   $actual_sha1"
        mismatch_count=$((mismatch_count + 1))
    fi
done

echo "Verification complete."
EOF

find /var/repo/maven -name '*.jar' -exec bash -c 'expected=$(cat "$1.sha1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "[:space:]"); actual=$(sha1sum "$1" 2>/dev/null | cut -d"" -f1); if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then echo "MISMATCH: $1"; fi' _ {} \;
